pt.B: Desprezar o próximo é pecado, \q mas como é feliz quem é bondoso com os humildes!
pt.R: É errado desprezar os outros. \q Feliz de verdade é quem trata bem os humildes.

am.L: ባልንጀራውን የሚንቅ ኃጢአት ይሠራል፤ \q ለትሑታን የሚራራ ግን እርሱ ምስጉን [ነው]።
am.B: ባልንጀራን መናቅ ኃጢአት ነው፤ \q ለትሑታን ደግ የሆነ ግን የተባረከ ነው።
am.R: ባልንጀራህን መናቅ ስሕተት ነው። \q ለትሑታን ደግ የሚሆኑትን ግን እግዚአብሔር ይባርካቸዋል።

hi.L: जो अपने पड़ोसी को तुच्छ जानता है, वह पाप करता है, \q पर जो दीनों पर दया करता है, वह कितना धन्य है।
hi.B: पड़ोसी को तुच्छ समझना पाप है, \q पर कितना धन्य है वह जो दीनों पर दया करता है।
hi.R: अपने पड़ोसी को नीचा समझना ग़लत है। \q परमेश्वर उन लोगों को आशीष देते हैं जो दीन लोगों पर दया करते हैं।

ru.L: Презирающий своего ближнего грешит, \q а милующий смиренных — блажен он.
ru.B: Презирать ближнего — грех, \q а блажен тот, кто добр к смиренным.
ru.R: Плохо смотреть свысока на своего ближнего. \q Счастлив тот, кто добр к смиренным людям.

ja.L: 自分の隣人をさげすむ者は罪を犯す。 \q しかし、へりくだる者たちに情けをかける者、その者は幸いなことよ。
ja.B: 隣人を見下すのは罪である。 \q しかし、へりくだる者に親切にする人は、なんと幸いなことか。
ja.R: 近所の人を見下すのは、悪いことだ。 \q 神は、へりくだる人に親切にする人を祝福してくださる。

decisions.choice: the humble, as the scribes' reading has it
decisions.reason: As in 3:34, the written consonants (ketiv) read "the poor" and the scribes' reading (qere) "the humble"; the two are often the same people in Scripture.

decisions.choice: how blessed: as in 3:13
decisions.reason: Verse 21 answers verse 20: God sees the poor differently.

decisions.choice: "phước thay [cho người ấy]"
decisions.reason: "Phước thay" is the cry of Psalm 1:1; Vietnamese needs to say who it is for, so Literal brackets "cho người ấy" where the Hebrew has only "he". No gender span: "người ấy" is already he or she.

decisions.choice: bem-aventurado (L); como é feliz (B); feliz de verdade (R)
decisions.reason: As 3:13 sets 'ashre for the whole book, after Psalm 1:1. Readable keeps the exclamation as "Feliz de verdade é quem ..." rather than following the English Readable "God blesses"; the meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: "bem-aventurado [é] ele", with no gender setting
decisions.reason: "Ele" refers back to "quem", which already means anyone, so Portuguese needs no setting where the English Literal offers "that one/he".

decisions.choice: "कितना धन्य है" (ashrei)
decisions.reason: The exclamation of 3:13 and Psalm 1:1 (meaning m2), in the form this translation uses there; Readable says God blesses them, as the English Readable does.
The scribes' reading has "the humble" or afflicted (meaning m1); "दीन" is the poetry note's word for them.

decisions.choice: "блажен" (L, B), "счастлив" (R) for ashrei
decisions.reason: The Psalms' forms for ashrei in this translation; Readable says "счастлив" where the English says "God blesses", since ashrei is a word of happiness, not of blessing.

decisions.choice: ashre "幸いなことよ" (L), "なんと幸いなことか" (B), as 3:13; Readable follows the English Readable "God blesses"
decisions.reason: The book's forms for ashre at Literal and Balanced; at Readable the English names God as the giver, and Japanese says it with くださる.

source.text: הֲֽלוֹא־יִ֭תְעוּ חֹ֣רְשֵׁי רָ֑ע וְחֶ֥סֶד וֶ֝אֱמֶ֗ת חֹ֣רְשֵׁי טֽוֹב׃

records.literal_gloss: Do not [those] devising evil go astray? But loyalty and faithfulness [belong to those] devising good.

en.L: Do not those who plot evil go astray? \q But loyal love and faithfulness [belong to] those who plan good.
en.B: Surely those who plot evil go astray, \q but those who plan good find loyal love and faithfulness.
en.R: People who plan to do evil lose their way. \q People who plan to do good are loved and trusted.

fr.L: Ne s’égarent-ils pas, ceux qui trament le mal ? \q Mais l’amour loyal et la fidélité [sont pour] ceux qui projettent le bien.
fr.B: Ceux qui trament le mal s’égarent assurément, \q mais ceux qui projettent le bien trouvent l’amour fidèle et la fidélité.
fr.R: Ceux qui préparent le mal se perdent. \q Ceux qui veulent faire le bien sont aimés et on leur fait confiance.

sw.L: Je, wale wapangao uovu hawapotei? \q Bali upendo usiokoma na uaminifu [ni kwa] wale wapangao mema.
sw.B: Hakika wanaopanga maovu hupotea njia, \q bali wanaopanga mema hupata upendo usiokoma na uaminifu.
sw.R: Watu wanaopanga kutenda maovu hupotea njia. \q Watu wanaopanga kutenda mema hupendwa na kuaminiwa.

es.L: ¿No se extravían los que traman el mal? \q Pero amor leal y fidelidad [son de] los que planean el bien.
es.B: Sin duda se extravían los que traman el mal, \q pero los que planean el bien hallan amor fiel y fidelidad.
es.R: Los que planean hacer el mal pierden el camino. \q A los que planean hacer el bien, los aman y confían en ellos.

vi.L: Há chẳng phải những kẻ mưu điều ác lầm lạc sao? \q Nhưng tình yêu thương thành tín và sự chân thật [thuộc về] những người mưu điều lành.
vi.B: Hẳn những kẻ mưu điều ác sẽ lầm đường lạc lối, \q còn những người dự tính điều lành gặp tình yêu thương thành tín và sự chân thật.
vi.R: Người dự tính làm điều ác sẽ lạc lối. \q Người dự tính làm điều tốt sẽ được tình thương thành tín và lòng tin cậy.

ko.L: 악을 꾀하는 자들은 길을 잃지 않겠느냐? \q 그러나 선을 계획하는 자들에게는 한결같은 사랑과 진실이 [있다].
ko.B: 악을 꾸미는 자들은 반드시 길을 잃지만, \q 선을 계획하는 사람들은 한결같은 사랑과 진실을 얻는다.
ko.R: 악한 일을 꾸미는 사람은 길을 잃는다. \q 선한 일을 계획하는 사람은 사랑과 믿음을 얻는다.

pt.L: Não se desviam os que tramam o mal? \q Mas amor leal e fidelidade [são dos] que planejam o bem.
pt.B: Certamente os que tramam o mal se perdem, \q mas os que planejam o bem encontram amor leal e fidelidade.
pt.R: Quem planeja fazer o mal perde o rumo. \q Quem planeja fazer o bem é amado e merece confiança.

am.L: ክፉን የሚያሤሩ አይስቱምን? \q ጽኑ ፍቅርና ታማኝነት ግን መልካምን ለሚያቅዱ [ናቸው]።
am.B: ክፉን የሚያሤሩ በእርግጥ ይስታሉ፤ \q መልካምን የሚያቅዱ ግን ጽኑ ፍቅርንና እውነትን ያገኛሉ።
am.R: ክፉ ለማድረግ የሚያቅዱ መንገዳቸውን ይስታሉ። \q መልካም ለማድረግ የሚያቅዱ ግን ይወደዳሉ፤ ይታመናሉም።

hi.L: क्या बुराई की युक्ति करनेवाले भटक नहीं जाते? \q पर भलाई की युक्ति करनेवालों के लिए अटल प्रेम और सच्चाई [है]।
hi.B: निश्चय ही बुराई की योजना बनानेवाले भटक जाते हैं, \q पर भलाई की योजना बनानेवाले कृपा और सच्चाई पाते हैं।
hi.R: जो लोग बुराई करने की योजना बनाते हैं, वे राह भटक जाते हैं। \q जो लोग भलाई करने की योजना बनाते हैं, उनसे लोग प्रेम करते हैं और उन पर भरोसा करते हैं।

ru.L: Не заблуждаются ли замышляющие зло? \q А неизменная любовь и верность — [у] замышляющих добро.
ru.B: Конечно, замышляющие зло сбиваются с пути, \q а тех, кто задумывает доброе, ждут милость и верность.
ru.R: Люди, которые замышляют зло, сбиваются с пути. \q А тех, кто задумывает доброе, любят и им доверяют.

ja.L: 悪を計る者たちは迷うではないか？ \q しかし、誠実とまことは、善を計る者たちに[ある]。
ja.B: 悪をたくらむ者は、必ず道を踏み外す。 \q しかし、善を計る者は、誠実とまことに出会う。
ja.R: 悪いことを計画する人は、道に迷う。 \q 良いことを計画する人は、愛され、信頼される。

decisions.choice: loyal love and faithfulness: as in 3:3
decisions.reason: They may be shown to those who plan good, by God and others, or be their own character.

decisions.choice: ḥesed: "l'amour loyal" at Literal, "l'amour fidèle" at Balanced and Readable, for the whole block
decisions.reason: The terms note's forms, so that ḥesed reads the same across Psalms and Proverbs. With "la fidélité" beside it, Balanced says "l'amour fidèle et la fidélité", as the Hebrew pairs two words of the same family.

decisions.choice: "upendo usiokoma" for hesed
decisions.reason: "Upendo usiokoma" (love that does not stop) is the term for hesed in Psalms and Proverbs; "fadhili" is kept for places where the English says "kindness".

decisions.choice: amor leal (L); amor fiel (B)
decisions.reason: Hesed is love that keeps faith with someone. 'Amor leal' at Literal and 'amor fiel' at Balanced say both the love and the loyalty; 'misericordia' would say only pity.

decisions.choice: "tình yêu thương thành tín" (L, B), "tình thương thành tín" (R) for hesed, with "sự chân thật" for emet
decisions.reason: Hesed is love that keeps faith; the shared terms list gives these words at each level, and they are used wherever hesed means loyal love in these chapters. The rare word spelled the same in 14:34 means shame and is not rendered with them.

decisions.choice: "한결같은 사랑" for hesed and "진실" for 'emet (L, B); Readable "사랑과 믿음" (love and trust)
decisions.reason: As the terms note: "한결같은 사랑" says the loyal love that keeps faith, at every level; "인자와 진리" is the familiar older pair. Readable says what the pair means for the people who plan good, being loved and trusted, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: amor leal e fidelidade
decisions.reason: Hesed is "o amor leal", as the Old Testament terms set it: love that keeps faith. "Misericórdia" would say only pity.

decisions.choice: ḥesed we-ʾemet: Literal "ጽኑ ፍቅርና ታማኝነት", Balanced "ጽኑ ፍቅርና እውነት", as the pair in Exodus 34:6
decisions.reason: The settled wording of the Exodus 34:6 formula, so the pair reads the same wherever it recurs (3:3; 16:6; 20:28).

decisions.choice: "अटल प्रेम" (L), "कृपा" (B); "सच्चाई"
decisions.reason: Hesed and emet as in 3:3 (meaning m1), where they are people's loyalty and reliability: the Pentateuch note gives hesed between people as "अटल प्रेम" at Literal and "कृपा" at Balanced.

decisions.choice: "неизменная любовь и верность" (L), "милость и верность" (B)
decisions.reason: The pair of 3:3 in this translation (m1), with hesed between people as the history note gives it.

source.text: בְּכָל־עֶ֭צֶב יִהְיֶ֣ה מוֹתָ֑ר וּדְבַר־שְׂ֝פָתַ֗יִם אַךְ־לְמַחְסֽוֹר׃

records.literal_gloss: In all toil there is profit, but [the] word of lips [leads] only to lack.

en.L: In all toil there is profit, \q but mere talk [leads] only to poverty.
en.B: All hard work brings a profit, \q but mere talk leads only to poverty.
en.R: If you work hard, you will gain something. \q If you only talk, you will end up poor.

fr.L: Dans toute peine il y a du profit, \q mais la parole des lèvres [ne mène] qu’à la disette.
fr.B: Tout travail pénible rapporte, \q mais le simple bavardage ne mène qu’à la pauvreté.
fr.R: Si tu travailles dur, tu gagneras quelque chose. \q Si tu ne fais que parler, tu finiras pauvre.

sw.L: Katika kila kazi ngumu kuna faida, \q bali maneno matupu [huleta] umaskini tu.
sw.B: Kila kazi ngumu huleta faida, \q bali maneno matupu huleta umaskini tu.
sw.R: Ukifanya kazi kwa bidii, utapata kitu. \q Ukiongea tu, utaishia kuwa maskini.

es.L: En todo trabajo hay provecho, \q pero la mera palabrería [lleva] solo a la pobreza.
es.B: Todo trabajo duro deja ganancia, \q pero hablar y hablar solo lleva a la pobreza.
es.R: Si trabajas duro, ganarás algo. \q Si solo hablas, terminarás pobre.

vi.L: Trong mọi công lao khó nhọc đều có lợi, \q nhưng lời nói suông [chỉ dẫn] đến thiếu thốn.
vi.B: Mọi việc làm cần cù đều đem lại lợi ích, \q còn chỉ nói suông thì dẫn đến nghèo túng.
vi.R: Ai làm việc chăm chỉ sẽ thu được điều gì đó. \q Ai chỉ biết nói thì rồi sẽ nghèo.

ko.L: 모든 수고에는 이익이 있지만, \q 입술의 말은 가난에 [이를] 뿐이다.
ko.B: 모든 힘든 일에는 이익이 따르지만, \q 말만 하는 것은 가난에 이를 뿐이다.
ko.R: 열심히 일하면 얻는 것이 있다. \q 말만 하면 가난해진다.

pt.L: Em todo trabalho árduo há proveito, \q mas a conversa dos lábios [leva] só à falta.
pt.B: Todo trabalho duro dá lucro, \q mas só falar leva à pobreza.
pt.R: Se você trabalha com empenho, vai ganhar alguma coisa. \q Se só fala, vai acabar pobre.

am.L: በድካም ሁሉ ትርፍ አለ፤ \q የከንፈር ቃል ግን ወደ ድህነት ብቻ [ይመራል]።
am.B: ብርቱ ሥራ ሁሉ ትርፍ ያመጣል፤ \q ወሬ ብቻ ግን ወደ ድህነት ይመራል።
am.R: ተግተህ ብትሠራ ታተርፋለህ። \q ብታወራ ብቻ ግን ትደኸያለህ።

hi.L: हर परिश्रम में लाभ है, \q पर होंठों की बात केवल घटी की ओर [ले जाती है]।
hi.B: हर कड़ी मेहनत से लाभ होता है, \q पर कोरी बातें केवल ग़रीबी लाती हैं।
hi.R: अगर तुम कड़ी मेहनत करोगे, तो तुम्हें कुछ लाभ होगा। \q अगर तुम केवल बातें करोगे, तो ग़रीब हो जाओगे।

ru.L: Во всяком труде есть польза, \q а пустые слова [ведут] только к нужде.
ru.B: Всякий тяжёлый труд приносит доход, \q а пустая болтовня ведёт лишь к бедности.
ru.R: Если трудишься, что-то приобретёшь. \q Если только говоришь, останешься бедным.

ja.L: すべての労苦には益がある。 \q しかし、唇の言葉は欠乏に[至る]のみ。
ja.B: どんな骨折りにも益がある。 \q しかし、口先だけの言葉は貧しさを招くだけだ。
ja.R: 一生懸命に働けば、何かを得る。 \q 口で言うだけなら、貧しくなる。

decisions.choice: a word of lips: empty talk
decisions.reason: Talk with no work behind it (2 Kings 18:20).
A word of lips is empty talk (meaning m1); Literal keeps the Hebrew's lips, Balanced says "mere talk" ("कोरी बातें").

source.text: עֲטֶ֣רֶת חֲכָמִ֣ים עָשְׁרָ֑ם אִוֶּ֖לֶת כְּסִילִ֣ים אִוֶּֽלֶת׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] crown of wise [people] [is] their wealth; [the] folly of fools [is] folly.

en.L: [The] crown of [the] wise [is] their wealth; \q [the] folly of fools [is] folly.
en.B: Wealth is a crown for the wise, \q but the folly of fools brings only folly.
en.R: Wise people are honored for what they have. \q Fools only become more foolish.

fr.L: [La] couronne des sages [est] leur richesse ; \q [la] folie des insensés [est] folie.
fr.B: La richesse est une couronne pour les sages, \q mais la folie des insensés n’apporte que la folie.
fr.R: Les sages sont honorés pour ce qu’ils ont. \q Les insensés deviennent seulement plus insensés.

sw.L: Taji la wenye hekima [ni] mali yao; \q upumbavu wa wapumbavu [ni] upumbavu.
sw.B: Mali ni taji kwa wenye hekima, \q bali upumbavu wa wapumbavu huzaa upumbavu tu.
sw.R: Watu wenye hekima huheshimiwa kwa vitu walivyo navyo. \q Wapumbavu huzidi kuwa wapumbavu tu.

es.L: [La] corona de [los] sabios [es] su riqueza; \q [la] necedad de los necios [es] necedad.
es.B: La riqueza es corona para los sabios, \q pero la necedad de los necios solo trae necedad.
es.R: A los sabios se les honra por lo que tienen. \q Los necios solo se vuelven más necios.

vi.L: Mão miện của người khôn ngoan [là] của cải của họ; \q sự ngu dại của kẻ ngu dại [là] sự ngu dại.
vi.B: Của cải là mão miện cho người khôn ngoan, \q còn sự ngu dại của kẻ ngu dại chỉ đem lại ngu dại.
vi.R: Người khôn ngoan được tôn trọng vì những gì họ có. \q Người ngu dại chỉ càng thêm ngu dại.

ko.L: 지혜로운 자들의 면류관은 그들의 부요함이고, \q 미련한 자들의 미련함은 미련함이다.
ko.B: 지혜로운 사람에게는 재물이 면류관이 되지만, \q 미련한 자들의 미련함은 미련함만 낳는다.
ko.R: 지혜로운 사람은 가진 것으로 존경을 받는다. \q 미련한 사람은 더 미련해질 뿐이다.

pt.L: A coroa dos sábios [é] a sua riqueza; \q a tolice dos insensatos [é] tolice.
pt.B: A riqueza é uma coroa para os sábios, \q mas a tolice dos insensatos só traz tolice.
pt.R: As pessoas sábias são honradas pelo que têm. \q Os tolos só ficam mais tolos.

am.L: የጠቢባን ዘውድ ሀብታቸው [ነው]፤ \q የሞኞች ስንፍና ስንፍና [ነው]።
am.B: ሀብት ለጠቢባን ዘውድ ነው፤ \q የሞኞች ስንፍና ግን ስንፍናን ብቻ ያመጣል።
am.R: ጠቢባን ባላቸው ነገር ይከበራሉ። \q የሞኞች ስንፍና ግን ይበልጥ ይጨምራል።

hi.L: बुद्धिमानों का मुकुट उनका धन [है]; \q मूर्खों की मूर्खता मूर्खता [ही है]।
hi.B: धन बुद्धिमानों के लिए मुकुट है, \q पर मूर्खों की मूर्खता से केवल मूर्खता ही निकलती है।
hi.R: बुद्धिमान लोगों को उनकी संपत्ति के कारण आदर मिलता है। \q मूर्ख केवल और भी मूर्ख बनते जाते हैं।

ru.L: Венец мудрых — их богатство; \q глупость глупцов — глупость.
ru.B: Богатство — венец для мудрых, \q а глупость глупцов приносит только глупость.
ru.R: Мудрых людей уважают за то, что у них есть. \q А глупцы становятся только глупее.

ja.L: 知恵ある者たちの冠は、その者たちの富。 \q 愚か者たちの愚かさは、愚かさ。
ja.B: 知恵ある者にとって、富は冠である。 \q しかし、愚か者の愚かさは、愚かさしか生まない。
ja.R: 知恵のある人は、持っているもののゆえに尊ばれる。 \q 愚かな人は、ますます愚かになるだけだ。

decisions.choice: folly is folly: fools gain nothing but more folly
alternatives: the garland of fools is folly (with a small change)
decisions.reason: The repetition is striking. Many read "the garland of fools is folly" to match the crown of the first line.

decisions.choice: "मूर्खता मूर्खता [ही है]"
decisions.reason: The repetition is the point: fools gain nothing but more folly (meaning m1); Literal keeps it, adding only "ही" in brackets.

source.text: מַצִּ֣יל נְ֭פָשׁוֹת עֵ֣ד אֱמֶ֑ת וְיָפִ֖חַ כְּזָבִ֣ים מִרְמָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: A true witness delivers lives, but [one who] breathes out lies [is] deceit.

en.L: A true witness saves lives, \q but one who breathes out lies [is a] deceiver.
en.B: A truthful witness saves lives, \q but one who pours out lies is a traitor.
en.R: An honest witness can save someone's life. \q A witness who lies betrays people.

fr.L: Un témoin véridique sauve des vies, \q mais qui exhale des mensonges [est un] trompeur.
fr.B: Le témoin qui dit vrai sauve des vies, \q mais celui qui débite des mensonges est un traître.
fr.R: Un témoin honnête peut sauver la vie de quelqu’un. \q Un témoin qui ment trahit les gens.

sw.L: Shahidi wa kweli huokoa nafsi, \q bali apumuaye uongo [ni] mdanganyifu.
sw.B: Shahidi wa kweli huokoa maisha, \q bali anayebubujika uongo ni msaliti.
sw.R: Shahidi mwaminifu anaweza kuokoa maisha ya mtu. \q Shahidi anayesema uongo huwasaliti watu.

es.L: El testigo veraz libra vidas, \q pero quien exhala mentiras [es un] engañador.
es.B: El testigo veraz salva vidas, \q pero el que derrama mentiras es un traidor.
es.R: Un testigo honrado puede salvar la vida de alguien. \q Un testigo que miente traiciona a la gente.

vi.L: Nhân chứng chân thật giải cứu mạng sống, \q nhưng kẻ thở ra lời dối trá [là kẻ] lừa gạt.
vi.B: Nhân chứng chân thật cứu được mạng người, \q còn kẻ tuôn ra lời dối trá là kẻ phản bội.
vi.R: Nhân chứng trung thực có thể cứu mạng một người. \q Nhân chứng nói dối thì phản bội người khác.

ko.L: 진실한 증인은 생명들을 건지지만, \q 거짓말을 내쉬는 자는 속이는 자이다.
ko.B: 진실한 증인은 사람의 목숨을 구하지만, \q 거짓말을 쏟아 내는 사람은 배신자이다.
ko.R: 정직한 증인은 사람의 목숨을 구할 수 있다. \q 거짓말하는 증인은 사람들을 배신한다.

pt.L: A testemunha verdadeira livra vidas, \q mas quem exala mentiras [é] enganador.
pt.B: A testemunha que fala a verdade salva vidas, \q mas quem derrama mentiras é um traidor.
pt.R: Uma testemunha honesta pode salvar a vida de alguém. \q Uma testemunha que mente trai as pessoas.

am.L: የእውነት ምስክር ነፍሳትን ያድናል፤ \q ውሸትን የሚተነፍስ ግን አታላይ [ነው]።
am.B: እውነተኛ ምስክር ሕይወትን ያድናል፤ \q ውሸትን የሚያዥጎደጉድ ግን አታላይ ነው።
am.R: ታማኝ ምስክር የሰውን ሕይወት ሊያድን ይችላል። \q የሚዋሽ ምስክር ግን ሰዎችን አሳልፎ ይሰጣል።

hi.L: सच्चा गवाह प्राणों को बचाता है, \q पर जो झूठ उगलता है, वह धोखेबाज़ [है]।
hi.B: सच बोलनेवाला गवाह जानें बचाता है, \q पर जो झूठ पर झूठ बोलता जाता है, वह विश्वासघाती है।
hi.R: सच्चा गवाह किसी की जान बचा सकता है। \q झूठ बोलनेवाला गवाह लोगों को धोखा देता है।

ru.L: Истинный свидетель спасает жизни, \q а выдыхающий ложь — обманщик.
ru.B: Правдивый свидетель спасает жизни, \q а тот, кто изливает ложь, — предатель.
ru.R: Честный свидетель может спасти человеку жизнь. \q А свидетель, который лжёт, предаёт людей.

ja.L: まことの証人は命を救い出す。 \q しかし、うそを吐き出す者は欺き[である]。
ja.B: 真実な証人は人の命を救う。 \q しかし、うそを並べ立てる者は裏切り者だ。
ja.R: 正直な証人は、人の命を救うことがある。 \q うそをつく証人は、人を裏切る。

decisions.choice: saves lives: in a court case
decisions.reason: A life could depend on testimony (Deuteronomy 19:15–19).

decisions.choice: "झूठ उगलता है" (L), "झूठ पर झूठ बोलता जाता है" (B), as 14:5
decisions.reason: The same phrase as 14:5; the lives saved are those of the accused in a court case (meaning m1).

decisions.choice: "жизни" for nefashot
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "душа" for nephesh elsewhere, but "спасает души" would read as salvation; the witness saves people's lives in court (m1).

source.text: בְּיִרְאַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה מִבְטַח־עֹ֑ז וּ֝לְבָנָ֗יו יִהְיֶ֥ה מַחְסֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: In [the] fear of YHWH [is] confidence of strength, and to his children there will be a refuge.

en.L: In [the] fear of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is] strong confidence, \q and for {{gender:their|his}} children there will be a refuge.
en.B: Whoever fears {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has a secure fortress, \q and their children will have a refuge.
en.R: People who honor {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} with awe feel safe. \q Their children will be safe too.

fr.L: Dans [la] crainte {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} [est] une ferme assurance, \q et pour ses enfants il y aura un refuge.
fr.B: Qui craint {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} possède une forteresse sûre, \q et ses enfants auront un refuge.
fr.R: Ceux qui honorent {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avec respect se sentent en sécurité. \q Leurs enfants seront en sécurité, eux aussi.

sw.L: Katika kumcha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [kuna] tumaini imara, \q na kwa watoto wake kutakuwa na kimbilio.
sw.B: Anayemcha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ana ngome iliyo salama, \q na watoto wake watakuwa na kimbilio.
sw.R: Watu wanaomheshimu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa hofu takatifu hujisikia salama. \q Watoto wao pia watakuwa salama.

es.L: En [el] temor {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} [hay] fuerte confianza, \q y para sus hijos habrá refugio.
es.B: Quien teme {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tiene una fortaleza segura, \q y sus hijos tendrán refugio.
es.R: Los que honran {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} con reverencia se sienten seguros. \q Sus hijos también estarán seguros.

vi.L: Trong sự kính sợ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [có] lòng tin cậy vững mạnh, \q và cho con cái người ấy sẽ có nơi ẩn náu.
vi.B: Người kính sợ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} có đồn lũy vững chắc, \q và con cái họ sẽ có nơi ẩn náu.
vi.R: Người tôn kính {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sẽ được an toàn. \q Con cái họ cũng sẽ được an toàn.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 경외함에는 든든한 신뢰가 [있고], \q 그의 자녀들에게는 피난처가 있을 것이다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 경외하는 사람에게는 튼튼한 요새가 있고, \q 그 자녀들에게도 피난처가 있다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 두려운 마음으로 섬기는 사람은 안심하며 산다. \q 그 자녀들도 안전할 것이다.

pt.L: No temor {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} [há] firme confiança, \q e para os seus filhos haverá refúgio.
pt.B: Quem teme {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tem uma fortaleza segura, \q e os seus filhos terão refúgio.
pt.R: Quem honra {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} com reverência se sente seguro. \q Os filhos dessa pessoa também vão estar seguros.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} በመፍራት ብርቱ መታመን [አለ]፤ \q ለልጆቹም መጠጊያ ይሆናል።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} የሚፈራ ጽኑ ምሽግ አለው፤ \q ልጆቹም መጠጊያ ይኖራቸዋል።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} የሚያከብሩና የሚፈሩ ሰዎች ደኅንነት ይሰማቸዋል። \q ልጆቻቸውም በሰላም ይኖራሉ።

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के भय में दृढ़ भरोसा [है], \q और उसकी सन्तान के लिए शरणस्थान होगा।
hi.B: जो {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का भय मानता है, उसके पास मज़बूत गढ़ है, \q और उसकी सन्तान को भी शरणस्थान मिलेगा।
hi.R: जो लोग {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का आदर और भय मानते हैं, वे सुरक्षित रहते हैं। \q उनकी सन्तान भी सुरक्षित रहेगी।

ru.L: В страхе перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Яхве}} — твёрдая уверенность, \q и для его детей будет прибежище.
ru.B: У того, кто боится {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}}, надёжная крепость, \q и его детям будет прибежище.
ru.R: Люди, которые чтят {{divine_name:ГОСПОДА|Яхве}} с благоговением, чувствуют себя в безопасности. \q И их дети тоже будут в безопасности.

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を恐れることのうちに、強い信頼がある。 \q そして、その子らには避け所がある。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を畏れる者には、堅固なとりでがある。 \q そして、その子どもたちにも逃れ場がある。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}をおそれ敬う人は、安心していられる。 \q その子どもたちも守られる。

decisions.choice: his children: the children of the one who fears the LORD
decisions.reason: "His" most likely refers to the person who fears the LORD; it could refer to the LORD, whose children find refuge in him.

decisions.choice: "kumheshimu BWANA kwa hofu takatifu" (to honor the LORD with holy awe) at Readable
decisions.reason: "Kumcha" is a word many young readers do not use; Readable says what the fear of the LORD is, as the English Readable says "honor the LORD with awe".

decisions.choice: el temor del SEÑOR (L); temer al SEÑOR (B); honrar al SEÑOR con reverencia (R)
decisions.reason: The fear of the LORD is awe and reverence that shapes how one lives, not fright. Literal and Balanced keep 'temor', the word Spanish uses for that awe; 'miedo' would mean being scared. Readable says what it is, 'honrar ... con reverencia', as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "con cái người ấy" (that person's children)
decisions.reason: "His children" most likely means the children of the one who fears the LORD (see the meaning decision). Vietnamese has to choose a pronoun here, and "người ấy" points to that person; "Ngài" would choose the other reading.

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 경외함" (L, B); "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 두려운 마음으로 섬기다" (R) for the fear of the LORD
decisions.reason: As the terms note. "경외" is awe and reverence, not terror; Readable says it in plain words, serving the LORD with awe, as the English Readable does. This holds for chapters 12-22.

decisions.choice: "os seus filhos", with no gender setting
decisions.reason: "Seus" leaves open whose children they are, as the Hebrew does (m1); Readable says "dessa pessoa", the likelier reading, as the English Readable says "their".

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का भय" (L, B); "... का आदर और भय मानना" (R)
decisions.reason: The fear of the LORD in the poetry note's forms, as in 1:7 and 10:27 of this translation.

decisions.choice: "उसकी सन्तान" (plain, not honorific)
decisions.reason: His children are the children of the one who fears the LORD (meaning m1). The plain "उसकी" makes that clear in Hindi, since the honorific "उनकी" would point to God; "शरणस्थान" is the poetry note's word for refuge.

decisions.choice: "страх перед ГОСПОДОМ" (L), "боится ГОСПОДА" (B), "чтят ГОСПОДА с благоговением" (R)
decisions.reason: The poetry note's forms for the fear of the LORD, as 1:7 and 9:10; Balanced and Readable turn the noun into a verb where the English does. "его детей" are the children of the one who fears (m1), so no deity_pronoun span.

decisions.choice: yir'at YHWH "主を恐れること" (L), "畏れる" (B), "おそれ敬う" (R), as 1:7 (also 14:27, 15:16, 15:33, 16:6)
decisions.reason: The book's three forms for the fear of the LORD; Readable おそれ敬う keeps both awe and honor, as the English Readable "honor with awe".

source.text: יִרְאַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה מְק֣וֹר חַיִּ֑ים לָ֝ס֗וּר מִמֹּ֥קְשֵׁי מָֽוֶת׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] fear of YHWH [is] a fountain of life, to turn aside from snares of death.

en.L: [The] fear of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is] a fountain of life, \q to turn [one] aside from [the] snares of death.
en.B: The fear of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is a spring of life, \q steering people away from the traps of death.
en.R: Honoring {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} with awe gives life. \q It keeps people away from things that lead to death.

fr.L: [La] crainte {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} [est] une source de vie, \q pour détourner des pièges de la mort.
fr.B: La crainte {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} est une source de vie, \q qui détourne des pièges de la mort.
fr.R: Honorer {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avec respect donne la vie. \q Cela tient loin de ce qui mène à la mort.

sw.L: Kumcha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] chemchemi ya uzima, \q kumwepusha [mtu] na mitego ya mauti.
sw.B: Kumcha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni chemchemi ya uzima, \q kukiwaepusha watu na mitego ya kifo.
sw.R: Kumheshimu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa hofu takatifu huleta uzima. \q Huwaepusha watu na mambo yanayoleta kifo.

es.L: [El] temor {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} [es] fuente de vida, \q para apartar [a uno] de [los] lazos de la muerte.
es.B: El temor {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} es manantial de vida, \q que aparta a la gente de las trampas de la muerte.
es.R: Honrar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} con reverencia da vida. \q Aleja a la gente de lo que lleva a la muerte.

vi.L: Sự kính sợ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [là] nguồn sự sống, \q để [giúp người] tránh khỏi những bẫy của sự chết.
vi.B: Sự kính sợ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là nguồn sự sống, \q dẫn người ta tránh xa những cạm bẫy của sự chết.
vi.R: Tôn kính {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đem lại sự sống. \q Điều đó giữ người ta tránh xa những gì dẫn đến cái chết.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 경외함은 생명의 샘이니, \q 죽음의 올무에서 벗어나게 한다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 경외함은 생명의 샘이어서, \q 사람들을 죽음의 덫에서 피하게 한다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 두려운 마음으로 섬기면 생명을 얻는다. \q 그렇게 하면 죽음으로 이끄는 것들을 피하게 된다.

pt.L: O temor {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} [é] fonte de vida, \q para desviar [alguém] dos laços da morte.
pt.B: O temor {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} é uma fonte de vida, \q que afasta as pessoas das armadilhas da morte.
pt.R: Honrar {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} com reverência dá vida. \q Isso afasta as pessoas do que leva à morte.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} መፍራት የሕይወት ምንጭ [ነው]፤ \q ከሞት ወጥመዶች ለመመለስ።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} መፍራት የሕይወት ምንጭ ነው፤ \q ሰዎችን ከሞት ወጥመዶች ያርቃል።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔርን|ያህዌን}} ማክበርና መፍራት ሕይወትን ይሰጣል። \q ሰዎች ወደ ሞት ከሚመሩ ነገሮች እንዲርቁ ይረዳቸዋል።

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का भय जीवन का सोता [है], \q कि [मनुष्य] मृत्यु के फंदों से बच निकले।
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का भय जीवन का झरना है, \q जो लोगों को मृत्यु के फंदों से दूर ले जाता है।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का आदर और भय मानने से जीवन मिलता है। \q यह लोगों को उन बातों से दूर रखता है जो मृत्यु की ओर ले जाती हैं।

ru.L: Страх перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Яхве}} — источник жизни, \q чтобы уклоняться от сетей смерти.
ru.B: Страх перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Яхве}} — родник жизни: \q он уводит людей от ловушек смерти.
ru.R: Благоговение перед {{divine_name:ГОСПОДОМ|Яхве}} даёт жизнь. \q Оно удерживает людей от того, что ведёт к смерти.

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を恐れることは命の泉、 \q 死のわなから離れるため[のもの]である。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}を畏れることは命の泉。 \q それは人を死のわなから遠ざける。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}をおそれ敬うことは、命を与える。 \q それは、死につながることから人を遠ざける。

decisions.choice: as 13:14, with the fear of the LORD
decisions.reason: 13:14 says the same of the teaching of the wise.

decisions.choice: the same wording as 13:14
decisions.reason: The second line is word for word the one of 13:14 (m1), so Literal and Balanced repeat its Portuguese.

decisions.choice: Worded as 13:14 at each level, with the fear of the LORD for the teaching of the wise
decisions.reason: Meaning decision m1: the two sayings differ only in their subject, and the Amharic keeps the rest the same.

decisions.choice: the wording of 13:14
decisions.reason: The saying repeats 13:14 with the fear of the LORD in place of the teaching of the wise (meaning m1), so the Hindi copies 13:14 at each level and changes only the subject.

decisions.choice: wording of 13:14
decisions.reason: The verse repeats 13:14 with the fear of the LORD in place of the teaching of the wise (m1), and the Russian repeats its wording.

source.text: בְּרָב־עָ֥ם הַדְרַת־מֶ֑לֶךְ וּבְאֶ֥פֶס לְ֝אֹ֗ם מְחִתַּ֥ת רָזֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: In a multitude of people [is the] glory of a king, but in lack of people [is the] ruin of a ruler.

en.L: In [the] multitude of people [is the] glory of a king, \q but without people a ruler [is] ruined.
en.B: A king's glory is in having many people; \q without people a ruler is ruined.
en.R: A king is great when he rules many people. \q A ruler with no people has nothing.

fr.L: Dans [la] multitude du peuple [est la] gloire du roi, \q mais faute de peuple, le prince [est] ruiné.
fr.B: La gloire d’un roi, c’est d’avoir un peuple nombreux ; \q sans peuple, un prince est ruiné.
fr.R: Un roi est grand quand il règne sur beaucoup de gens. \q Un chef sans peuple n’a rien.

sw.L: Katika wingi wa watu [ni] utukufu wa mfalme, \q bali bila watu mtawala [ameangamia].
sw.B: Utukufu wa mfalme ni kuwa na watu wengi; \q bila watu mtawala ameangamia.
sw.R: Mfalme ni mkuu anapotawala watu wengi. \q Mtawala asiye na watu hana kitu.

es.L: En [la] multitud del pueblo [está la] gloria del rey, \q pero sin pueblo el gobernante [está] arruinado.
es.B: La gloria de un rey está en tener mucho pueblo; \q sin pueblo, el gobernante está perdido.
es.R: Un rey es grande cuando gobierna a mucha gente. \q Un gobernante sin pueblo no tiene nada.

vi.L: Dân đông [là] vinh quang của vua, \q nhưng thiếu dân [là] sự sụp đổ của người cai trị.
vi.B: Vinh quang của vua ở nơi dân đông; \q không có dân, người cai trị sẽ sụp đổ.
vi.R: Vua được vẻ vang khi cai trị nhiều dân. \q Người cai trị không có dân thì chẳng có gì.

ko.L: 백성이 많은 데에 왕의 영광이 [있고], \q 백성이 없으면 통치자가 망한다.
ko.B: 백성이 많은 것이 왕의 영광이요, \q 백성이 없으면 통치자는 망한다.
ko.R: 다스리는 백성이 많아야 왕이 위대해진다. \q 백성이 없는 통치자는 아무것도 아니다.

pt.L: Na multidão do povo [está a] glória do rei, \q mas sem povo o governante [está] arruinado.
pt.B: A glória do rei está em ter muitos súditos; \q sem povo, o governante está arruinado.
pt.R: Um rei é grande quando governa muita gente. \q Um governante sem povo não tem nada.

am.L: በሕዝብ ብዛት የንጉሥ ክብር [አለ]፤ \q ሕዝብ በማጣት ግን ገዥ ይጠፋል።
am.B: የንጉሥ ክብር በሕዝቡ ብዛት ነው፤ \q ሕዝብ የሌለው ገዥ ግን ይጠፋል።
am.R: ንጉሥ ታላቅ የሚሆነው ብዙ ሕዝብ ሲገዛ ነው። \q ሕዝብ የሌለው ገዥ ምንም የለውም።

hi.L: प्रजा की बहुतायत में राजा की महिमा [है], \q पर प्रजा की कमी में शासक का विनाश [है]।
hi.B: राजा की महिमा बहुत सी प्रजा होने में है; \q प्रजा के बिना शासक बरबाद है।
hi.R: राजा तब महान होता है जब वह बहुत से लोगों पर राज्य करता है। \q जिस शासक के पास प्रजा नहीं, उसके पास कुछ नहीं।

ru.L: Во множестве народа — слава царя, \q а без народа правитель погиб.
ru.B: Слава царя — в многочисленном народе; \q без народа правитель гибнет.
ru.R: Царь велик, когда правит многими людьми. \q У правителя без народа нет ничего.

ja.L: 民の多いことに、王の栄誉がある。 \q しかし、民がいないことに、君主の滅びがある。
ja.B: 王の栄誉は、民の多いことにある。 \q 民がいなければ、君主は滅びる。
ja.R: 多くの民を治める王は、偉大だ。 \q 民のいない支配者には、何もない。

decisions.choice: a king's glory: a large, thriving population
decisions.reason: A king's strength lay in his people; their well-being is his honor.

decisions.choice: "प्रजा"
decisions.reason: The people here are a king's subjects, a large and thriving population (meaning m1); "प्रजा" is the Hindi word for them.

source.text: אֶ֣רֶךְ אַ֭פַּיִם רַב־תְּבוּנָ֑ה וּקְצַר־ר֝֗וּחַ מֵרִ֥ים אִוֶּֽלֶת׃

records.literal_gloss: [One] long of anger [has] great understanding, but [one] short of spirit exalts folly.

en.L: [One] slow to anger [has] great understanding, \q but [one] quick-tempered exalts folly.
en.B: Patience shows great understanding, \q but a quick temper puts folly on display.
en.R: People who are slow to get angry are very wise. \q People who get angry quickly show how foolish they are.

fr.L: [Celui qui est] lent à la colère [a] une grande intelligence, \q mais [celui qui est] prompt à s’emporter exalte la folie.
fr.B: La patience montre une grande intelligence, \q mais l’emportement met la folie en vitrine.
fr.R: Ceux qui sont lents à se fâcher sont très sages. \q Ceux qui se fâchent vite montrent combien ils sont insensés.

sw.L: [Mtu] asiye mwepesi wa hasira [ana] ufahamu mwingi, \q bali mwenye hasira za haraka huutukuza upumbavu.
sw.B: Uvumilivu huonyesha ufahamu mkubwa, \q bali hasira za haraka huonyesha upumbavu hadharani.
sw.R: Watu wasiokasirika haraka wana hekima nyingi. \q Watu wanaokasirika haraka huonyesha jinsi walivyo wapumbavu.

es.L: [El] lento para la ira [tiene] gran entendimiento, \q pero [el] que se enoja pronto ensalza la necedad.
es.B: La paciencia muestra gran entendimiento, \q pero el mal genio pone en evidencia la necedad.
es.R: Los que tardan en enojarse son muy sabios. \q Los que se enojan rápido muestran lo necios que son.

vi.L: [Người] chậm giận [có] sự thông sáng lớn, \q nhưng [kẻ] nóng tính đề cao sự ngu dại.
vi.B: Kiên nhẫn cho thấy sự thông sáng lớn, \q còn tính nóng nảy phô bày sự ngu dại.
vi.R: Người chậm nổi giận là người rất khôn ngoan. \q Người dễ nổi giận cho thấy mình dại dột đến mức nào.

ko.L: 노하기를 더디 하는 자는 큰 명철이 [있지만], \q 성급한 자는 미련함을 드높인다.
ko.B: 참을성이 있는 것은 큰 명철을 보여 주지만, \q 성급한 성질은 미련함을 드러낸다.
ko.R: 쉽게 화내지 않는 사람은 깨달음이 깊다. \q 쉽게 화내는 사람은 자기가 얼마나 미련한지 보여 준다.

pt.L: [Quem é] lento para a ira [tem] grande entendimento, \q mas [quem] se irrita depressa exalta a tolice.
pt.B: A paciência mostra grande entendimento, \q mas o gênio explosivo põe a tolice à mostra.
pt.R: Quem demora a ficar com raiva é muito sábio. \q Quem fica com raiva rápido mostra como é tolo.

am.L: ለቁጣ የዘገየ ታላቅ ማስተዋል [አለው]፤ \q ቁጡ ግን ስንፍናን ከፍ ያደርጋል።
am.B: ቶሎ የማይቆጣ ታላቅ ማስተዋል አለው፤ \q ቁጡ ግን ስንፍናውን በአደባባይ ያሳያል።
am.R: ቶሎ የማይቆጡ ሰዎች በጣም ጠቢባን ናቸው። \q ቶሎ የሚቆጡ ግን ምን ያህል ሰነፎች እንደ ሆኑ ያሳያሉ።

hi.L: जो क्रोध करने में धीमा है, [उसमें] बड़ी समझ [है], \q पर जो उतावली आत्मा का है, वह मूर्खता को ऊँचा करता है।
hi.B: धीरज बड़ी समझ दिखाता है, \q पर जल्दी भड़कनेवाला स्वभाव मूर्खता का प्रदर्शन करता है।
hi.R: जो लोग जल्दी क्रोधित नहीं होते, वे बहुत समझदार हैं। \q जो लोग जल्दी क्रोधित हो जाते हैं, वे दिखा देते हैं कि वे कितने मूर्ख हैं।

ru.L: Медленный на гнев — велик разумом, \q а скорый духом превозносит глупость.
ru.B: Терпение показывает великий разум, \q а вспыльчивость выставляет глупость напоказ.
ru.R: Люди, которые не спешат гневаться, очень мудры. \q А те, кто быстро злится, показывают, как они глупы.

ja.L: 怒るのに遅い者は、大いなる英知[を持つ]。 \q しかし、気の短い者は、愚かさを高く掲げる。
ja.B: 怒るのに遅いことは、大いなる英知の表れ。 \q しかし、短気は愚かさをさらけ出す。
ja.R: なかなか怒らない人は、とても知恵がある。 \q すぐに怒る人は、自分の愚かさを見せる。

decisions.choice: long of anger: patient
decisions.reason: See verse 17.

decisions.choice: "l'intelligence" for tevunah and binah at Literal and Balanced, for the whole block
decisions.reason: The terms note's word: understanding as the ability to see how things are and act on it.

decisions.choice: "명철" (L, B); "깨달음" (R) for binah and tevunah
decisions.reason: As the terms note: "명철" is the established word for this insight; Readable uses the native word "깨달음". This holds for chapters 12-22.

decisions.choice: "slow to anger": Literal "ለቁጣ የዘገየ", Balanced "ቶሎ የማይቆጣ", as Exodus 34:6; "quick-tempered" "ቁጡ", as 14:17
decisions.reason: The same Hebrew phrase as Exodus 34:6, said there of God; the settled wording lets the reader hear it.

decisions.choice: "क्रोध करने में धीमा"
decisions.reason: "Long of anger" means patient (meaning m1); Literal uses the phrase the Psalms of this translation use for God's patience (Psalm 103:8), "slow to anger".

source.text: חַיֵּ֣י בְ֭שָׂרִים לֵ֣ב מַרְפֵּ֑א וּרְקַ֖ב עֲצָמ֣וֹת קִנְאָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] life of [the] body [is] a heart of health, but rottenness of bones [is] envy.

en.L: A heart at peace [is the] life of [the] body, \q but envy [is] rot in [the] bones.
en.B: A calm heart gives life to the body, \q but envy is decay in the bones.
en.R: Being calm and at peace keeps your body healthy. \q But jealousy is like a disease that eats away your bones.

fr.L: Un cœur paisible [est la] vie du corps, \q mais la jalousie [est] une pourriture dans les os.
fr.B: Un cœur calme donne la vie au corps, \q mais l’envie est une pourriture dans les os.
fr.R: Être calme et en paix garde ton corps en bonne santé. \q Mais la jalousie est comme une maladie qui te ronge les os.

sw.L: Moyo wenye amani [ni] uzima wa mwili, \q bali wivu [ni] uozo katika mifupa.
sw.B: Moyo uliotulia huupa mwili uhai, \q bali wivu ni uozo mifupani.
sw.R: Kuwa mtulivu na mwenye amani huufanya mwili wako uwe na afya. \q Lakini wivu ni kama ugonjwa unaokula mifupa yako.

es.L: Un corazón en paz [es la] vida del cuerpo, \q pero la envidia [es] podredumbre en [los] huesos.
es.B: Un corazón tranquilo da vida al cuerpo, \q pero la envidia es carcoma en los huesos.
es.R: Estar tranquilo y en paz mantiene sano tu cuerpo. \q Pero los celos son como una enfermedad que te carcome los huesos.

vi.L: Lòng bình an [là] sự sống của thân thể, \q nhưng lòng ghen tị [là] sự mục nát trong xương cốt.
vi.B: Lòng bình tĩnh đem lại sự sống cho thân thể, \q còn lòng ghen tị là sự mục nát trong xương cốt.
vi.R: Lòng bình an giữ cho thân thể khỏe mạnh. \q Nhưng lòng ghen tị giống như bệnh tật gặm mòn xương cốt.

ko.L: 평온한 마음은 몸의 생명이지만, \q 시기는 뼈 속의 썩음이다.
ko.B: 평온한 마음은 몸에 생기를 주지만, \q 시기는 뼈를 썩게 한다.
ko.R: 마음이 평안하면 몸도 건강하다. \q 그러나 질투는 뼈를 갉아먹는 병과 같다.

pt.L: Um coração em paz [é a] vida do corpo, \q mas a inveja [é] podridão nos ossos.
pt.B: Um coração tranquilo dá vida ao corpo, \q mas a inveja corrói os ossos.
pt.R: Ter calma e paz faz bem à saúde do corpo. \q Mas o ciúme é como uma doença que vai comendo os ossos.

am.L: የተረጋጋ ልብ የሥጋ ሕይወት [ነው]፤ \q ቅንዓት ግን ለአጥንት ብስባሽ [ነው]።
am.B: የተረጋጋ ልብ ለአካል ሕይወትን ይሰጣል፤ \q ቅንዓት ግን በአጥንት ውስጥ መበስበስ ነው።
am.R: መረጋጋትና ሰላም ሰውነትህን ጤናማ ያደርገዋል። \q ቅናት ግን አጥንትህን እንደሚበላ በሽታ ነው።

hi.L: शान्त मन शरीर का जीवन [है], \q पर जलन हड्डियों की सड़न [है]।
hi.B: शान्त मन शरीर को जीवन देता है, \q पर डाह हड्डियों में सड़न है।
hi.R: शान्त और चैन से रहने से तुम्हारा शरीर स्वस्थ रहता है। \q पर जलन ऐसे रोग के समान है जो तुम्हारी हड्डियों को खा जाता है।

ru.L: Спокойное сердце — жизнь для тела, \q а зависть — гниль в костях.
ru.B: Спокойное сердце даёт жизнь телу, \q а зависть — тление в костях.
ru.R: Спокойствие и мир в душе сохраняют тело здоровым. \q А зависть — как болезнь, которая разъедает кости.

ja.L: 健やかな心は体の命。 \q しかし、ねたみは骨の腐れ。
ja.B: 穏やかな心は体に命を与える。 \q しかし、ねたみは骨を腐らせる。
ja.R: 心が落ち着いて安らかなら、体も健康でいられる。 \q しかし、ねたみは、骨をむしばむ病気のようだ。

decisions.choice: envy: jealousy, passion
decisions.reason: The word (qinah) is jealousy or burning passion (6:34).

decisions.choice: "जलन" (L, R); "डाह" (B)
decisions.reason: The word means envy or jealous passion (meaning m1); "जलन" and "डाह" are the Hindi words for envy that burns within.

source.text: עֹ֣שֵֽׁקדָּ֭ל חֵרֵ֣ף עֹשֵׂ֑הוּ וּ֝מְכַבְּד֗וֹ חֹנֵ֥ן אֶבְיֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: [One] oppressing [the] poor insults his Maker, but [one] showing favor [to the] needy honors him.

en.L: Whoever oppresses [the] poor insults {{gender:their|his}} Maker, \q but whoever is kind to [the] needy honors {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: Whoever oppresses the poor insults the One who made them, \q but kindness to the needy honors {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: If you are cruel to poor people, you insult God, who made them. \q If you are kind to people in need, you honor God.

fr.L: Qui opprime [le] pauvre outrage son Créateur, \q mais qui fait grâce à [l’]indigent {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}honore.
fr.B: Qui opprime le pauvre outrage Celui qui l’a fait, \q mais la bonté envers l’indigent {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}honore.
fr.R: Si tu es dur avec les pauvres, tu insultes Dieu, qui les a créés. \q Si tu es bon avec les gens dans le besoin, tu honores Dieu.

sw.L: Amwoneaye maskini humtukana Muumba wake, \q bali amhurumiaye mhitaji humheshimu.
sw.B: Anayemwonea maskini humtukana yule aliyemuumba, \q bali kumhurumia mhitaji ni kumheshimu {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}.
sw.R: Ukiwa mkatili kwa watu maskini, unamtukana Mungu aliyewaumba. \q Ukiwa mwema kwa wahitaji, unamheshimu Mungu.

es.L: Quien oprime al pobre insulta a su Hacedor, \q pero quien es bondadoso con [el] necesitado {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} honra.
es.B: Quien oprime al pobre insulta a quien lo hizo, \q pero la bondad con el necesitado {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} honra.
es.R: Si eres cruel con los pobres, insultas a Dios, que los hizo. \q Si eres bondadoso con los necesitados, honras a Dios.

vi.L: Ai áp bức người nghèo là sỉ nhục Đấng Tạo Hóa của mình, \q nhưng ai thương xót người thiếu thốn là tôn kính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Ai áp bức người nghèo là sỉ nhục Đấng đã dựng nên họ, \q còn lòng thương xót người thiếu thốn tôn kính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Ai đối xử tàn nhẫn với người nghèo là sỉ nhục Đức Chúa Trời, Đấng đã dựng nên họ. \q Ai tử tế với người thiếu thốn là tôn kính Đức Chúa Trời.

ko.L: 가난한 자를 학대하는 자는 그를 지으신 분을 모욕하지만, \q 궁핍한 자에게 은혜를 베푸는 자는 그분을 공경한다.
ko.B: 가난한 사람을 억누르는 사람은 그를 지으신 분을 모욕하지만, \q 궁핍한 사람에게 친절을 베푸는 것은 그분을 공경하는 것이다.
ko.R: 가난한 사람에게 못되게 굴면 그 사람을 지으신 하나님을 모욕하는 것이다. \q 궁핍한 사람에게 친절하면 하나님을 높이는 것이다.

pt.L: Quem oprime o pobre insulta o seu Criador, \q mas quem é bondoso com o necessitado {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} honra.
pt.B: Quem oprime o pobre insulta o Criador dele, \q mas a bondade com o necessitado {{deity_pronoun:o|O}} honra.
pt.R: Se você é cruel com os pobres, insulta a Deus, que os criou. \q Se é bondoso com quem passa necessidade, honra a Deus.

am.L: ድሀን የሚጨቁን ፈጣሪውን ይሰድባል፤ \q ለምስኪን የሚራራ ግን ያከብረዋል።
am.B: ድሆችን የሚጨቁን የሠራቸውን ይሰድባል፤ \q ለምስኪኖች ደግነት ማሳየት ግን ያከብረዋል።
am.R: ለድሆች ጨካኝ ብትሆን የሠራቸውን እግዚአብሔርን ትሰድባለህ። \q ለተቸገሩ ደግ ብትሆን ግን እግዚአብሔርን ታከብራለህ።

hi.L: जो ग़रीब पर अंधेर करता है, वह उसके सृजनहार का अपमान करता है, \q पर जो दरिद्र पर दया करता है, वह उनका आदर करता है।
hi.B: जो ग़रीब पर अत्याचार करता है, वह उसके सृजनहार का अपमान करता है, \q पर दरिद्र पर दया करना उनका आदर करना है।
hi.R: अगर तुम ग़रीबों से क्रूर व्यवहार करते हो, तो तुम परमेश्वर का अपमान करते हो, जिन्होंने उन्हें बनाया है। \q अगर तुम ज़रूरतमंद लोगों पर दया करते हो, तो तुम परमेश्वर का आदर करते हो।

ru.L: Угнетающий бедного оскорбляет его Создателя, \q а милующий нищего чтит {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}.
ru.B: Кто угнетает бедного, оскорбляет его Создателя, \q а кто добр к нищему, тот чтит {{deity_pronoun:его|Его}}.
ru.R: Если ты жесток с бедными людьми, ты оскорбляешь Бога, который их создал. \q Если ты добр к людям в нужде, ты чтишь Бога.

ja.L: 貧しい者を虐げる者は、自分の造り主をそしる。 \q しかし、乏しい者をあわれむ者は、その方を敬う。
ja.B: 貧しい者を虐げる者は、その人を造られた方をそしる。 \q しかし、乏しい者に親切にすることは、その方を敬うことだ。
ja.R: 貧しい人にひどいことをするなら、その人を造られた神をばかにしている。 \q 困っている人に親切にするなら、神を敬っている。

decisions.choice: his Maker: God, who made rich and poor
decisions.reason: God made the poor as he made everyone (22:2; Job 31:15). To oppress them is to insult him; to help them honors him (19:17; Matthew 25:40).

decisions.choice: his Maker: the oppressor's Maker or the poor man's
decisions.reason: "His" may point to the oppressor or to the poor. Either way, God is the Maker of both.

decisions.choice: "Đấng Tạo Hóa của mình" (his own Maker) at Literal
alternatives: "Đấng Tạo Hóa của họ" (the poor man's Maker)
decisions.reason: "của mình" points back to the one who oppresses, the nearer reading, but leaves room for the other (see the meaning decisions); Balanced says "Đấng đã dựng nên họ" (who made them), as the English Balanced does.

decisions.choice: o seu Criador
decisions.reason: Literal's "seu" can point to the oppressor or to the poor, as the Hebrew can (m2); Balanced says "o Criador dele", the poor man's Maker, as the English Balanced says "the One who made them".

decisions.choice: Literal "ፈጣሪውን" (his Maker) leaves "his" open as the Hebrew does; Balanced "የሠራቸውን" (the one who made them) follows the English Balanced
decisions.reason: Meaning decision m2: "his" may be the oppressor's Maker or the poor man's.

decisions.choice: "उसके सृजनहार" (the poor man's Maker)
decisions.reason: "His Maker" may be the oppressor's or the poor man's (meaning m2); the Hindi must choose between "अपने" (the oppressor's) and "उसके" (another's), and follows the English Balanced, which reads it as the poor man's Maker. Either way the Maker is God, who made rich and poor (m1); "सृजनहार" is the word Job uses in this translation.

decisions.choice: "его Создателя"
decisions.reason: The participle "the one who made him" names God as Maker (m1); "его" keeps open whose Maker is meant, the oppressor's or the poor man's (m2), where "своего" would decide it.

decisions.choice: "自分の造り主" (L) keeps the Hebrew's open "his Maker"; Balanced and Readable "その人を造られた方 / 神" as the English, with respect forms for God
decisions.reason: m2: the Maker may be the oppressor's or the poor man's; Literal leaves it open as the Hebrew does.

source.text: בְּֽ֭רָעָתוֹ יִדָּחֶ֣ה רָשָׁ֑ע וְחֹסֶ֖ה בְמוֹת֣וֹ צַדִּֽיק׃

records.literal_gloss: By his wickedness a wicked [person] is thrust down, but [the] righteous [person] takes refuge in his death.

en.L: [The] wicked is thrust down by {{gender:their|his}} wickedness, \q but [the] righteous takes refuge in {{gender:their|his}} death.
en.B: The wicked are brought down by their own evil, \q but the righteous have a refuge even in death.
en.R: Evil people are destroyed by their own evil. \q But good people trust God even when they die.

fr.L: [Le] méchant est renversé par sa méchanceté, \q mais [le] juste trouve refuge dans sa mort.
fr.B: Les méchants sont abattus par leur propre mal, \q mais le juste a un refuge jusque dans la mort.
fr.R: Les méchants sont détruits par leur propre mal. \q Mais les justes font confiance à Dieu même quand ils meurent.

sw.L: Mwovu hutupwa chini kwa uovu wake, \q bali mwenye haki hupata kimbilio katika kifo chake.
sw.B: Waovu huangushwa na uovu wao wenyewe, \q bali wenye haki wana kimbilio hata katika kifo.
sw.R: Watu waovu huangamizwa na uovu wao wenyewe. \q Lakini watu wema humtumaini Mungu hata wanapokufa.

es.L: [El] malvado es derribado por su maldad, \q pero [el] justo halla refugio en su muerte.
es.B: Los malvados caen por su propia maldad, \q pero los justos tienen refugio aun en la muerte.
es.R: Los malvados son destruidos por su propia maldad. \q Pero las personas buenas confían en Dios aun cuando mueren.

vi.L: Kẻ ác bị xô ngã bởi sự gian ác của mình, \q nhưng người công chính tìm được nơi ẩn náu trong sự chết của mình.
vi.B: Kẻ ác bị chính điều ác mình làm quật ngã, \q còn người công chính vẫn có nơi ẩn náu ngay cả trong sự chết.
vi.R: Kẻ ác bị hủy diệt bởi chính điều ác của mình. \q Nhưng người công chính vẫn tin cậy Đức Chúa Trời ngay cả khi chết.

ko.L: 악인은 자기 악으로 넘어지지만, \q 의인은 자기 죽음 가운데서도 피할 곳을 찾는다.
ko.B: 악인은 자기 악 때문에 쓰러지지만, \q 의인은 죽음 앞에서도 피난처가 있다.
ko.R: 악한 사람은 자기 악 때문에 망한다. \q 그러나 바르게 사는 사람은 죽을 때에도 하나님을 의지한다.

pt.L: O ímpio é derrubado pela sua maldade, \q mas o justo se refugia na sua morte.
pt.B: Os ímpios são derrubados pela própria maldade, \q mas os justos têm refúgio até na morte.
pt.R: As pessoas más são destruídas pela própria maldade. \q Mas as pessoas boas confiam em Deus até quando morrem.

am.L: ክፉ በክፋቱ ይገፋል፤ \q ጻድቅ ግን በሞቱ መጠጊያ ያገኛል።
am.B: ክፉዎች በገዛ ክፋታቸው ይወድቃሉ፤ \q ጻድቃን ግን በሞትም እንኳ መጠጊያ አላቸው።
am.R: ክፉ ሰዎች በገዛ ክፋታቸው ይጠፋሉ። \q መልካም ሰዎች ግን በሚሞቱበት ጊዜ እንኳ በእግዚአብሔር ይታመናሉ።

hi.L: दुष्ट अपनी दुष्टता से गिरा दिया जाता है, \q पर धर्मी अपनी मृत्यु में [भी] शरण पाता है।
hi.B: दुष्ट अपनी ही बुराई से गिराए जाते हैं, \q पर धर्मियों के लिए मृत्यु में भी शरणस्थान है।
hi.R: दुष्ट लोग अपनी ही बुराई से नाश हो जाते हैं। \q पर भले लोग मरते समय भी परमेश्वर पर भरोसा रखते हैं।

ru.L: Нечестивый низвергается своим злом, \q а праведный укрывается в своей смерти.
ru.B: Нечестивых губит их собственное зло, \q а у праведных есть прибежище даже в смерти.
ru.R: Злых людей губит их собственное зло. \q А праведные люди доверяют Богу, даже когда умирают.

ja.L: 悪しき者は、自分の悪によって突き倒される。 \q しかし、正しい者は、自分の死においても身を避ける。
ja.B: 悪しき者は、自分の悪によって倒される。 \q しかし、正しい人は、死の中にも逃れ場を持つ。
ja.R: 悪い人は、自分の悪のために滅びる。 \q しかし、正しい人は、死ぬときにも神に信頼する。

decisions.choice: in his death, as the Hebrew text has it
alternatives: in his integrity (the ancient Greek translation)
decisions.reason: The ancient Greek translation reads "in his integrity", which differs by two letters in Hebrew. As it stands, the Hebrew expresses hope beyond death.

decisions.choice: trust God
decisions.reason: Readable names God as the refuge, which the Hebrew implies (14:26).

decisions.choice: "अपनी मृत्यु में [भी]"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text reads "in his death" (meaning m1); the Greek Old Testament reads "in his integrity". The Hindi follows the Hebrew, as the English does, and Readable names God as the refuge, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "укрывается" for chasah
decisions.reason: The Psalms' Literal word for taking refuge; the Hebrew "in his death" is kept as it stands (m1).

source.text: בְּלֵ֣ב נָ֭בוֹן תָּנ֣וּחַ חָכְמָ֑ה וּבְקֶ֥רֶב כְּ֝סִילִ֗ים תִּוָּדֵֽעַ׃

records.literal_gloss: In [the] heart of [one] understanding wisdom rests, and in [the] inner part of fools it is made known.

en.L: Wisdom rests in [the] heart of [one who] understands, \q and in [the] midst of fools it is made known.
en.B: Wisdom is at home in the heart of the discerning, \q and even among fools it makes itself known.
en.R: Wisdom lives in the hearts of people who understand. \q Even fools can see it.

fr.L: La sagesse repose dans [le] cœur de [celui qui] comprend, \q et au milieu des insensés elle se fait connaître.
fr.B: La sagesse est chez elle dans le cœur de celui qui a de l’intelligence, \q et même parmi les insensés elle se fait connaître.
fr.R: La sagesse habite le cœur de ceux qui comprennent. \q Même les insensés peuvent la voir.

sw.L: Hekima hukaa moyoni mwa [yule] mwenye ufahamu, \q na katikati ya wapumbavu hujulikana.
sw.B: Hekima hukaa nyumbani katika moyo wa mwenye ufahamu, \q na hata miongoni mwa wapumbavu hujitambulisha.
sw.R: Hekima huishi mioyoni mwa watu wenye ufahamu. \q Hata wapumbavu wanaweza kuiona.

es.L: En [el] corazón del entendido reposa la sabiduría, \q y en medio de [los] necios se da a conocer.
es.B: La sabiduría habita en el corazón del que discierne, \q y aun entre los necios se deja ver.
es.R: La sabiduría vive en el corazón de los que entienden. \q Hasta los necios pueden verla.

vi.L: Sự khôn ngoan an nghỉ trong lòng [người] thông sáng, \q và giữa những kẻ ngu dại, nó được tỏ ra.
vi.B: Sự khôn ngoan ở yên trong lòng người thông sáng, \q và ngay giữa những kẻ ngu dại, nó cũng tự tỏ mình ra.
vi.R: Sự khôn ngoan sống trong lòng người hiểu biết. \q Ngay cả người ngu dại cũng có thể nhận ra nó.

ko.L: 지혜는 명철한 자의 마음에 머물고, \q 미련한 자들 가운데서도 알려진다.
ko.B: 지혜는 분별 있는 사람의 마음에 자리 잡고, \q 미련한 자들 가운데서도 자신을 드러낸다.
ko.R: 지혜는 깨달음이 있는 사람의 마음에 산다. \q 미련한 사람들도 지혜를 알아본다.

pt.L: A sabedoria repousa no coração [de quem] entende, \q e no meio dos insensatos ela se faz conhecer.
pt.B: A sabedoria mora no coração dos que têm discernimento, \q e até entre os insensatos ela se dá a conhecer.
pt.R: A sabedoria vive no coração de quem entende. \q Até os tolos conseguem vê-la.

am.L: በአስተዋይ ልብ ጥበብ ታርፋለች፤ \q በሞኞችም መካከል ትታወቃለች።
am.B: ጥበብ በአስተዋይ ልብ ውስጥ ትኖራለች፤ \q በሞኞች መካከል እንኳ ራሷን ታሳውቃለች።
am.R: ጥበብ በአስተዋይ ሰዎች ልብ ትኖራለች። \q ሞኞች እንኳ ሊያዩአት ይችላሉ።

hi.L: समझदार के मन में बुद्धि विश्राम करती है, \q और मूर्खों के बीच में वह प्रकट की जाती है।
hi.B: समझ रखनेवाले के मन में बुद्धि का घर होता है, \q और मूर्खों के बीच भी वह अपने आप को प्रकट कर देती है।
hi.R: बुद्धि उन लोगों के मन में रहती है जो समझते हैं। \q मूर्ख भी उसे देख सकते हैं।

ru.L: В сердце разумного покоится мудрость, \q и среди глупцов она становится известной.
ru.B: Мудрость живёт в сердце разумного, \q и даже среди глупцов она даёт о себе знать.
ru.R: Мудрость живёт в сердцах тех, кто понимает. \q Даже глупцы могут её увидеть.

ja.L: 悟りのある者の心に、知恵はとどまる。 \q そして、愚か者たちのただ中でも、それは知られる。
ja.B: 知恵は、悟りのある者の心に安らぐ。 \q 愚か者たちの間でも、知恵は自らを現す。
ja.R: 知恵は、物事がよくわかる人の心に住んでいる。 \q 愚かな人でさえ、それに気づく。

decisions.choice: it is made known: wisdom shows itself even among fools
alternatives: it is not known (the ancient Greek)
decisions.reason: The line is unclear. It may mean that wisdom is recognized even among fools, or (with the ancient Greek) that fools do not know it.

decisions.choice: "बुद्धि" with feminine verbs
decisions.reason: Wisdom is the subject of both lines and shows itself even among fools (meaning m1); "बुद्धि" is feminine in Hindi, as in Hebrew, so the verbs follow.

source.text: צְדָקָ֥ה תְרֽוֹמֵֽם־גּ֑וֹי וְחֶ֖סֶד לְאֻמִּ֣ים חַטָּֽאת׃

records.literal_gloss: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin [is] a disgrace to peoples.

en.L: Righteousness exalts a nation, \q but sin [is] a disgrace to any people.
en.B: Righteousness lifts a nation up, \q but sin brings disgrace on any people.
en.R: A nation becomes great when its people do what is right. \q Sin brings shame on any nation.

fr.L: La justice élève une nation, \q mais le péché [est] la honte des peuples.
fr.B: La justice fait grandir une nation, \q mais le péché couvre de honte n’importe quel peuple.
fr.R: Une nation devient grande quand son peuple fait ce qui est juste. \q Le péché couvre de honte n’importe quelle nation.

sw.L: Haki hulikweza taifa, \q bali dhambi [ni] fedheha kwa mataifa.
sw.B: Haki hulipandisha taifa juu, \q bali dhambi huwaletea aibu watu wowote.
sw.R: Taifa huwa kubwa watu wake wanapotenda yaliyo haki. \q Dhambi huleta aibu kwa taifa lolote.

es.L: La justicia engrandece a la nación, \q pero el pecado [es] afrenta para cualquier pueblo.
es.B: La justicia levanta a una nación, \q pero el pecado trae deshonra a cualquier pueblo.
es.R: Una nación se hace grande cuando su gente hace lo que es justo. \q El pecado trae vergüenza a cualquier nación.

vi.L: Sự công chính nâng cao một nước, \q nhưng tội lỗi [là] sự sỉ nhục cho mọi dân.
vi.B: Sự công chính làm cho một nước được nâng cao, \q còn tội lỗi đem nhục nhã cho bất cứ dân nào.
vi.R: Một nước trở nên vĩ đại khi dân chúng làm điều đúng. \q Tội lỗi đem lại sự xấu hổ cho bất cứ nước nào.

ko.L: 의는 나라를 높이지만, \q 죄는 백성들에게 수치이다.
ko.B: 의는 나라를 일으켜 세우지만, \q 죄는 어느 백성에게나 수치를 가져온다.
ko.R: 백성이 옳은 일을 하면 나라가 위대해진다. \q 죄는 어느 나라든지 부끄럽게 만든다.

pt.L: A justiça exalta uma nação, \q mas o pecado [é] vergonha para qualquer povo.
pt.B: A justiça eleva uma nação, \q mas o pecado traz desonra a qualquer povo.
pt.R: Uma nação se torna grande quando o seu povo faz o que é certo. \q O pecado traz vergonha para qualquer nação.

am.L: ጽድቅ ሕዝብን ከፍ ያደርጋል፤ \q ኃጢአት ግን ለማንኛውም ወገን ውርደት [ነው]።
am.B: ጽድቅ ሕዝብን ከፍ ከፍ ያደርጋል፤ \q ኃጢአት ግን በማንኛውም ወገን ላይ ውርደትን ያመጣል።
am.R: ሕዝቡ ትክክል የሆነውን ሲያደርግ አገር ታላቅ ትሆናለች። \q ኃጢአት ግን ማንኛውንም ሕዝብ ያሳፍራል።

hi.L: धार्मिकता जाति को ऊँचा करती है, \q पर पाप हर प्रजा का कलंक [है]।
hi.B: धार्मिकता किसी राष्ट्र को ऊँचा उठाती है, \q पर पाप हर प्रजा पर कलंक लगाता है।
hi.R: जब किसी देश के लोग सही काम करते हैं, तो वह देश महान बनता है। \q पाप किसी भी देश को लज्जित करता है।

ru.L: Праведность возвышает народ, \q а грех — позор для любого племени.
ru.B: Праведность поднимает народ, \q а грех навлекает позор на любое племя.
ru.R: Народ становится великим, когда его люди поступают правильно. \q А грех приносит стыд любому народу.

ja.L: 義は国を高める。 \q しかし、罪はもろもろの民の恥。
ja.B: 義は国を高く上げる。 \q しかし、罪はどの民にも恥をもたらす。
ja.R: 国の人々が正しいことを行うと、その国は偉大になる。 \q 罪は、どの国にも恥をもたらす。

decisions.choice: disgrace: a different word from hesed, "loyal love"
decisions.reason: The word spelled hesed here is a rare word meaning shame or reproach (Leviticus 20:17), not the common word for loyal love.

decisions.choice: "ውርደት" (disgrace) for the rare ḥesed of this line, not "ጽኑ ፍቅር"; "ሕዝብ" for the nation (goy) and "ወገን" for the peoples (leʾummim), as the terms list where both stand together
decisions.reason: Meaning decision m1: the word spelled like ḥesed here means shame or reproach.

decisions.choice: "जाति" (L), "राष्ट्र" (B), "देश" (R); "कलंक" (disgrace)
decisions.reason: The nation in the poetry note's forms: "जाति" at Literal, and at Balanced and Readable words that cannot be read as caste. The word for disgrace is a different word from hesed, "loyal love" (meaning m1); "कलंक" says disgrace.

decisions.choice: "позор" for hesed here
decisions.reason: This hesed is a rarer word of the same sound meaning disgrace (m1), not loyal love; "неизменная любовь" would mislead.

source.text: רְֽצוֹן־מֶ֭לֶךְ לְעֶ֣בֶד מַשְׂכִּ֑יל וְ֝עֶבְרָת֗וֹ תִּהְיֶ֥ה מֵבִֽישׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] favor of a king [is] for a servant acting wisely, but his fury [is for one] acting shamefully.

en.L: A king's favor [goes] to a servant who acts wisely, \q but his wrath [falls on one] who acts shamefully.
en.B: A king shows favor to a wise servant, \q but his anger falls on one who disgraces him.
en.R: A king is pleased with a servant who acts wisely. \q But he is angry with one who brings him shame.

fr.L: La faveur du roi [va] au serviteur qui agit sagement, \q mais sa colère [frappe celui] qui fait honte.
fr.B: Le roi accorde sa faveur au serviteur avisé, \q mais sa colère tombe sur celui qui le déshonore.
fr.R: Un roi est content d’un serviteur qui agit avec sagesse. \q Mais il est en colère contre celui qui lui fait honte.

sw.L: Kibali cha mfalme [ni] kwa mtumishi atendaye kwa hekima, \q bali ghadhabu yake [ni juu ya] yule atendaye kwa aibu.
sw.B: Mfalme humpendelea mtumishi mwenye hekima, \q bali hasira yake humwangukia anayemwaibisha.
sw.R: Mfalme hupendezwa na mtumishi anayetenda kwa hekima. \q Lakini humkasirikia mtumishi anayemletea aibu.

es.L: [El] favor del rey [es] para el siervo que actúa con sabiduría, \q pero su furor [cae sobre el] que actúa vergonzosamente.
es.B: El rey favorece al siervo sabio, \q pero su enojo cae sobre el que lo deshonra.
es.R: Un rey está contento con un siervo que actúa con sabiduría. \q Pero se enoja con el que lo avergüenza.

vi.L: Ân huệ của vua [dành cho] đầy tớ hành động khôn ngoan, \q nhưng cơn thịnh nộ của vua [đổ trên kẻ] làm điều đáng hổ thẹn.
vi.B: Vua ban ơn cho bề tôi khôn ngoan, \q còn cơn giận của vua đổ trên kẻ làm vua hổ thẹn.
vi.R: Vua hài lòng với bề tôi biết hành động khôn ngoan. \q Nhưng vua nổi giận với kẻ làm vua xấu hổ.

ko.L: 왕의 은총은 지혜롭게 행하는 신하에게 [가지만], \q 그의 진노는 수치스럽게 행하는 자에게 [내린다].
ko.B: 왕은 지혜로운 신하에게 은총을 베풀지만, \q 자기를 욕되게 하는 신하에게는 진노를 내린다.
ko.R: 왕은 지혜롭게 일하는 신하를 기뻐한다. \q 그러나 자기를 부끄럽게 하는 신하에게는 화를 낸다.

pt.L: O favor do rei [vai] para o servo que age com sabedoria, \q mas a sua ira [cai sobre quem] age vergonhosamente.
pt.B: O rei favorece o servo sábio, \q mas a sua ira cai sobre quem o desonra.
pt.R: O rei fica contente com um servo que age com sabedoria. \q Mas fica com raiva de quem o envergonha.

am.L: የንጉሥ ሞገስ በጥበብ ለሚሠራ ባሪያ [ነው]፤ \q ቁጣው ግን በሚያሳፍር [ላይ ይሆናል]።
am.B: ንጉሥ ለጠቢብ ሹም ሞገስን ያሳያል፤ \q ቁጣው ግን በሚያዋርደው ላይ ይወርዳል።
am.R: ንጉሥ በጥበብ በሚሠራ ሹሙ ደስ ይለዋል። \q የሚያሳፍረው ሹም ግን ያስቆጣዋል።

hi.L: राजा का अनुग्रह बुद्धि से काम करनेवाले दास पर [होता है], \q पर उसका कोप लज्जा के काम करनेवाले पर [पड़ता है]।
hi.B: राजा बुद्धिमान अधिकारी पर कृपा करता है, \q पर जो उसे लज्जित करता है, उस पर उसका क्रोध भड़कता है।
hi.R: राजा उस अधिकारी से प्रसन्न होता है जो बुद्धिमानी से काम करता है। \q पर जो अधिकारी उसे लज्जित करता है, उससे वह क्रोधित होता है।

ru.L: Благоволение царя — к рабу, поступающему мудро, \q а его гнев [падает на] поступающего постыдно.
ru.B: Царь благоволит мудрому приближённому, \q а его гнев обрушивается на того, кто его позорит.
ru.R: Царь доволен приближённым, который поступает мудро. \q А на того, кто приносит ему позор, он гневается.

ja.L: 王の好意は、賢くふるまうしもべに[向かう]。 \q しかし、王の激しい怒りは、恥ずべきふるまいをする者に[下る]。
ja.B: 王は賢いしもべに好意を示す。 \q しかし、王に恥をかかせる者には、怒りが下る。
ja.R: 王は、賢くふるまう家来を喜ぶ。 \q しかし、王に恥をかかせる家来には、腹を立てる。

decisions.choice: a king's servant: a royal official
decisions.reason: Many sayings in chapters 14–16 are about life at a king's court.

decisions.choice: servo
decisions.reason: The servant here is a royal official (m1), not a slave, so Literal too says "servo", as the English Literal says "servant".

decisions.choice: A king's servant: Literal "ባሪያ", Balanced and Readable "ሹም" (official)
decisions.reason: Meaning decision m1: a royal official. The settled wording for the king's servants in Kings and Chronicles is ባሪያዎች (L) / ሹማምንት (B, R).
A king's servant is a royal official (meaning m1); the history note gives the king's officials as "दास" at Literal and "अधिकारी" at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: "раб" (L), "приближённый" (B, R) for the king's eved
decisions.reason: The history note's words for the king's officials (m1).

decisions.choice: 'eved of a royal official "しもべ" (L, B), "家来" (R), as the English "servant" at every level
decisions.reason: m1: a king's servant is an official; the English keeps "servant" at Literal, so Japanese does not use 奴隷; Readable uses the courtier word of 2 Samuel.
